title: Build SpecifiedCell, SpecPill, and StateBadge components
description:
Create three components for the Specified column:

**1. `dashboard/frontend/components/define/specified-cell.tsx` — SpecifiedCell**
Renders the left column for each feature row. Contains:
- Feature name (13px/500, truncate at 32 chars)
- StateBadge next to name
- Three SpecPill components (Product, Technical, Design)
- Audit warnings: warning count + warning text lines (11px, --color-amber)
- Open questions count (11px, --color-text-tertiary)
- Sizing estimate when present
- Compact variant for unplanned features (single-line, padding 10px 20px)
- Full variant for complete/executing/writing (padding 16px 20px)

**2. `dashboard/frontend/components/define/spec-pill.tsx` — SpecPill**
Three-state indicator pill:
- `present`: emerald bg `rgba(68,204,119,0.06)`, text `--color-emerald`
- `warning`: amber bg `rgba(240,178,50,0.06)`, text `--color-amber`
- `missing`: bg `--color-bg-card`, dashed border `--color-text-tertiary`, text `--color-text-tertiary`
- Label in --font-mono, 9px/500
- Props: label ('Product' | 'Technical' | 'Design'), state ('present' | 'warning' | 'missing')

**3. `dashboard/frontend/components/define/state-badge.tsx` — StateBadge**
Lifecycle badge:
- COMPLETE: emerald bg/text
- EXECUTING: accent bg/text
- WRITING: violet bg/text
- UNPLANNED: neutral bg, tertiary text
- Font: --font-mono, 8px/600, uppercase
- Props: state ('complete' | 'executing' | 'writing' | 'unplanned')

Derive SpecPill state from feature data: `exists=false` → missing, `exists=true && auditStatus='warning'||'error'` → warning, else → present.
acceptance_criteria:
- SpecifiedCell renders feature name truncated at 32 chars with ellipsis
- SpecifiedCell renders StateBadge and three SpecPill components
- SpecifiedCell shows audit warning count and text when present
- SpecifiedCell renders compact variant for unplanned features
- SpecPill renders three visual states with correct colors (present/emerald, warning/amber, missing/dashed)
- SpecPill uses --font-mono at 9px/500
- StateBadge renders four states with correct per-state colors
- StateBadge uses --font-mono at 8px/600 uppercase
- No hardcoded colors outside token system

spec_references.requirement: Spec pill colors for present/warning/missing, state badge colors per state
Feature name 13px/500, spec pill 9px/500 mono, state badge 8px/600 mono
Spec pill state derived from exists + auditStatus
S1: spec indicators, S3: audit warnings per feature, S4: lifecycle-state-based structure

rationale: The Specified column is the most visually complex column with the most sub-components. Grouped together because SpecPill and StateBadge are only used inside SpecifiedCell. Depends on task 8 (the page shell that renders these cells) to ensure the grid context exists.
assumptions: SpecPill derives state from SpecIndicator fields per design spec Data Binding section
decisions: Writing state badge changed from violet to amber (rgba(240,178,50,0.08) bg, --color-amber text) to match design spec and existing DefinePanel.tsx pattern
letterSpacing changed from 0.06em to 0.03em to match design spec typography table
totalWarnings now derives from allWarnings.length instead of summing warningCount fields, eliminating potential count/text divergence when caller data is inconsistent
Did NOT modify page.tsx — previous attempt failed scope check for touching that file (owned by task 12)
concerns: The 'missing' pill uses a dashed-border visual rather than the opacity:0.35 dimming described in the design spec Implementation Notes. The reviewer flagged this as needing explicit confirmation. The task description specifies dashed border for missing state, so I kept the current implementation, but this deviation from the design spec's 'dim to opacity 0.35' language remains unresolved.
